premise.claim: Installing a second Fluid helm release on the same cluster fails with 'exists and cannot be imported into the current release' ownership conflicts (issue #6134).
premise.evidence: results/p0-install2.log (fails on ServiceAccount alluxioruntime-controller, values-default layout) and results/p0b-install2.log (with --set namespace=test, fails on exactly the reported ClusterRole alluxioruntime-controller).

findings.title: Incomplete fix: second release still cannot install (CSIDriver fuse.csi.fluid.io and MutatingWebhookConfiguration fluid-pod-admission-webhook keep fixed cluster-scoped names); 'Fixes #6134' does not hold
findings.observed: head chart: second install fails with default values (namespaced SA collision) and with --set namespace=test (CSIDriver fuse.csi.fluid.io ownership conflict)

findings.title: Upgrade swaps ClusterRole/ClusterRoleBinding names (delete+create): brief permission-loss window for runtime controllers
tests: scripts/scenario.sh: F2.install, F2.before, F2.upgrade, F2.oldgone, F2.newexists, F2.subjects
findings.observed: helm upgrade base->head succeeds; old-name objects deleted, new-name objects created; bindings keep referencing the same ServiceAccounts
findings.expected: mechanics confirmed; transient window disclosed by author in PR body

findings.title: Chart tests assert template text only; no helm template/render or multi-install e2e coverage; glob misses templates outside role/ and upgrade/
findings.evidence: results/unit-head.log (pass on head), results/unit-base-bites.log (38 failures on base)
